_about: The 36 minigames as weapons and spells (SPEC.md › Attacks and spells). gameId is the legacy game id. kind: attack | spell | area | versus. family drives affixes and region bias. stat is the governing stat; lever describes how each point above/below 3 bends the odds (implemented in packages/games/levers.js). topMult is what counts as a critical hit when reached. starter marks the shared starter kit; classStart names the class whose starting weapon it is.
